notes: Signing back in is quicker: the app now remembers the employee code you last signed in with, so after signing out you only have to type your password. Only the code is kept — your password is never stored on the phone. Attendance regularization can now carry a monthly limit. Where the company sets one, the screen tells you how many corrections you have left before you fill anything in. The count is against the month you are correcting, so filing late for last month does not spend this month's allowance, and a request that was rejected costs you nothing. If you have run out, HR can still raise the correction for you. Alongside this build, on the web: the regularization Approval setup screen — who signs off whose corrections, and the monthly limit itself — can now be given to an HR by a Super Admin on its own, without also handing over reporting lines and HR partners. One number covers the whole company, and a single person can be given a different one. Also, clicking a point on the joiners-vs-exits chart in Analytics now lists everyone for that month, instead of only the line you happened to click.
